fit_reason: Whole 2018 Ram Promaster service-body van listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Unpainted black plastic front bumper and lower cladding look slightly grey and faded, especially around the front wheel arches
Black rear bumper looks a bit dull and grey
Light road film on the lower doors and rocker area of the cab
Headlight lenses look slightly hazy in the front shot
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Promaster KUV service van. It looks clean overall, but the black front bumper and wheel arch trim are starting to fade grey and the headlights look a little hazy. We do mobile pre-sale details, including trim and headlight restoration, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
